title: Priority: the store identity checks the Fly app name
evidence: app/lib/store.server.ts takes the shop from SHOPIFY_SHOP_DOMAIN alone (PR 1516). Cross-check it against FLY_APP_NAME at boot: health-tool-edu must mean the edu shop, health-tool-app the brand shop; fail loudly on a mismatch. Accept only the two known shop domains, exactly (after a trim), and refuse any other value instead of reading it as the brand shop
